Th is petition coming on for orders this day, t h e court passed the following:
 ORDER

Learned counsel for petitioner at the very outset prays for withdrawal of this petition assailing the FIR bearing Crime No.462/2022 registered at Police Station Omti, Jabalpur alleging offences punishable u/Ss.201, 274, 275, 304, 420, 467, 468, 471 r/w S.34 and 120-B of IPC, Section 53 of Disaster Management Act, 2005, Section 3 of Epidemic Diseases Act, 1897 and Section 13 of Drugs Control Act, 1950 and the order dated 14.09.2022 passed by JMFC, Jabalpur allowing application u/S.156(3) of Cr.P.C. preferred by the complainant/respondent No.2.
2.
Learned counsel seeks liberty to file a properly constituted petition.
